results.sql:
SELECT INGRESOS, GASTOS FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO_MES = '2026-03'
LIMIT 200

SELECT ANIO, NUMERO_MES, INGRESOS, GASTOS, UTILIDAD FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 6
LIMIT 200

SELECT SUM(IFF(ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 6, UTILIDAD, 0)) AS UTILIDAD_JUNIO, SUM(IFF(ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 5, UTILIDAD, 0)) AS UTILIDAD_MAYO, SUM(IFF(ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 6, UTILIDAD, 0)) - SUM(IFF(ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 5, UTILIDAD, 0)) AS DIFERENCIA_ABSOLUTA, CASE WHEN SUM(IFF(ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 5, UTILIDAD, 0)) <> 0 THEN (SUM(IFF(ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 6, UTILIDAD, 0)) - SUM(IFF(ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 5, UTILIDAD, 0))) / SUM(IFF(ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 5, UTILIDAD, 0)) * 100 END AS DIFERENCIA_PCT FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES IN (5,6)
LIMIT 200
SELECT CATEGORIA, SUM(MONTO_TOTAL) AS TOTAL_GASTO_2026 FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_CATEGORIA_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2026 AND TIPO = 'GASTO' GROUP BY CATEGORIA ORDER BY TOTAL_GASTO_2026 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AREA, SUM(MONTO_TOTAL) AS GASTO_TOTAL_2025 FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_AREA_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2025 AND TIPO = 'GASTO' GROUP BY AREA ORDER BY GASTO_TOTAL_2025 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(MONTO_TOTAL) AS GASTO_MARKETING_MARZO_2026 FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_CATEGORIA_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 3 AND TIPO = 'GASTO' AND CATEGORIA = 'MARKETING'
LIMIT 200

SELECT MONTO_TOTAL AS GASTO_LOGISTICA_AGOSTO_2026 FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_CATEGORIA_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES = 8 AND TIPO = 'GASTO' AND CATEGORIA = 'LOGISTICA'
LIMIT 200

SELECT MES, ANIO_MES, NIVEL, TIPO, CATEGORIA, TIPO_ANOMALIA, MOTIVO, VALOR_OBSERVADO, VALOR_ESPERADO, Z_SCORE FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.ANOMALIAS ORDER BY MES
LIMIT 200

SELECT SUM(IFF(NUMERO_MES BETWEEN 1 AND 6, INGRESOS, 0)) AS INGRESOS_PRIMER_SEMESTRE, SUM(IFF(NUMERO_MES BETWEEN 1 AND 6, GASTOS, 0)) AS GASTOS_PRIMER_SEMESTRE, SUM(IFF(NUMERO_MES BETWEEN 7 AND 12, INGRESOS, 0)) AS INGRESOS_SEGUNDO_SEMESTRE, SUM(IFF(NUMERO_MES BETWEEN 7 AND 12, GASTOS, 0)) AS GASTOS_SEGUNDO_SEMESTRE FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2026
LIMIT 200
SELECT ANIO_MES, MARGEN_PCT FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2026 ORDER BY MARGEN_PCT ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(MONTO_TOTAL) AS TOTAL_INGRESOS_VENTA_CONTADO_2025 FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_CATEGORIA_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2025 AND TIPO = 'INGRESO' AND CATEGORIA = 'VENTA CONTADO'
LIMIT 200

SELECT SUM(MONTO_TOTAL) AS TOTAL_NOMINA_Q1_2026 FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_CATEGORIA_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2026 AND NUMERO_MES IN (1,2,3) AND TIPO = 'GASTO' AND CATEGORIA = 'NOMINA'
LIMIT 200

SELECT MOTIVO_RECHAZO, COUNT(*) AS CANTIDAD FROM DATAFINANCE.SILVER.TRANSACCIONES_RECHAZADOS GROUP BY MOTIVO_RECHAZO ORDER BY CANTIDAD DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_TRANSACCIONES FROM DATAFINANCE.SILVER.TRANSACCIONES WHERE ANIO = 2025 AND MONTH(FECHA) = 12
LIMIT 200

SELECT SUM(MONTO_TOTAL) AS INGRESOS_ADMINISTRACION FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_AREA_MENSUAL WHERE TIPO='INGRESO' AND AREA='ADMINISTRACIÓN'
LIMIT 200

SELECT INGRESOS FROM DATAFINANCE.GOLD.KPI_MENSUAL WHERE ANIO = 2020 AND NUMERO_MES = 1
LIMIT 200
